Application Description

Fine is the all-in-one photo and video editor. Pro color tools, powerful AI and a complete creative studio, in one app. Edit photos, RAW files, videos and Live Photos, then design collages and posters, without switching apps. AI TOOLS • AI Erase: tap to remove objects, people and text, or fix spots with Heal and Clone • AI Relight: add new light to a photo after it's taken, in 2D or 3D • Retouch: natural skin, face reshaping, eyes, makeup and Liquify • AI Enhance: upscale, sharpen, denoise and restore photos and videos • Replace Sky, DSLR Bokeh and one-tap Cutout PRO COLOR • Light, Color, Details, HSL, Color Grading, Levels, Black & White and more • Six kinds of curves: RGB, Hue, Lab, CMYK, Saturation and Luminance • Masks for every tool: AI selection of subject, sky, face and hair, plus brush, gradients and color range • RAW Editor for ProRAW and camera RAW files • Import your own LUTs (.cube) and save your own presets FILTERS & EFFECTS • 1,500+ filters in the Filter Shop • 160+ artistic effects: anime, sketch, watercolor, mosaic, glitch, glass and more • Color Match copies the look of any photo CREATE & DESIGN • Layers with 27 blend modes, Harmonize and text behind the subject • Text with templates, glow, warp and your own fonts • 3D Text in glass, ice and metal, with real lights and shadows • Shapes, stickers and a full brush engine for doodles • 500+ poster templates, 99 collage layouts and photo stitching VIDEO & LIVE PHOTOS • Multi-track timeline: trim, split, speed curves and keyframes • 200+ transitions, text animations, music and AI voice noise reduction • Edit Live Photos with filters, stickers, text and animation, and save them as Live Photos • Export up to 4K BUILT FOR REAL WORK • Non-destructive history: go back to any step and change it • Batch edit: edit one photo and sync the edits to the rest • Copy and paste edits, save versions, and pick up any project later • Manual camera with RAW capture and live filters • Export as JPG, PNG or HEIC with full quality control FINE VIP Fine VIP unlocks all premium tools, filters, effects and templates, with monthly and yearly subscription options. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your App Store account settings. Terms of Use: https://fine.youthpe.com/terms Privacy Policy: https://fine.youthpe.com/privacy

-- Awards: ● 2021 BitSummit THE 8th BIT: Official Selection ● Busan Indie Connect 2020: Excellence in Casual ● Bahamut 2020 ACG Creation Contest: Bronze Award About: Dungeon and Puzzles is a game that challenges players' 2D spatial perception and logical thinking. A player can use a sword to attack monsters, or a bow and an arrow to destroy enemies from afar. Pushing the obstacles back with a shield and pulling the monsters with a pair of special gloves. There are 150 handcrafted rooms in the dungeon. Players will have to get a better understanding of the game to solve the puzzles and clear the rooms. To beat the puzzles with fewer moves, achieving advanced goals, players will have to try different tactics and move combinations to find an optimized solution for the room. Sometimes a player would need to put the old solution aside and take on a new perspective towards the problem, reexamine and rethink before making a move. entry.title: Little Big Workshop
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$10.99 → $1.99 [$1.99 ~ $10.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$1.99

Application Description

Imagine a magical factory, appearing right in your living room. A carefully planned masterpiece, where diligent workers throw together anything customers want. Rubber ducks and dressers, drones and electric guitars, scooters and other wonderful goods can be created from many different materials and sold for hard cash – cash you invest right back into your factory to get more machines, more workers and grow your business. In Little Big Workshop you become a factory tycoon! Real factories - made FUN You are the Big Boss and it’s time to take charge of your very own tabletop factory. Organize the factory floor, manage your workers, purchase machinery, and design efficient production lines - all within the time-limit and to your client's satisfaction! An open-ended sandbox-experience Take it easy, it’s a sandbox-experience where you think, ponder and poke at things until you get it to work the way you’d like. Supply products to clients and an ever-changing market, as you produce over 50 unique product types, built from multiple parts and pieces - all of which can be created with different materials and production methods. No two factories should ever look the same. Tiny hands, big dreams Start out with just a small workshop and expand to a desk-filling factory. Unlock ever fancier machines, add even more production methods, and most of all, more room. Soon enough you’ll be running multiple production lines, producing hundreds of advanced products each day, and watching with joy as your cute workers do the actual work. Features: - Varying industries and a wide range of products - Focus on practical problems, not on values, economics, or logistics - Organize all steps of the production on a blueprint - Factories grow as you unlock more desk space - Fully simulated Day/Night-cycle - Take care of your workers! Work them too hard and they drop like flies - Cute model-town art-style

The Squadron has reached your mobile device! Dodge a bullet storm and face fearsome aerial war machines! Dodge bullets, collect massive power-ups and wisely use special abilities to defeat your enemies. Two campaigns with 50 levels in total, waves of various deadly enemies and a lot of epic boss fights. Application Description

Burn rubber and shred metal in the ultimate driving playground! Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. • Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas. • Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... Application Description

Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely. Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming. Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead. TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level. CARRY ONE THING FORWARD Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for.
